verdict.rationale: Your own tooling can drive v0 programmatically through the Platform API and SDK, which expose chats, project management and deployment, and support custom chat interfaces. GitHub integration (branches, PRs, import from GitHub) gives an external agent an indirect way to work on the same code. There is no documented way to plug in a third-party coding agent as the builder's engine or to replace the built-in agent. Missing for 10: a native bring-your-own-agent or MCP/agent hookup, documented two-way sync of externally made agent commits back into the v0 chat, and hands-on corroboration of an external-agent workflow.
